identification: Wheel-thrown red/buff earthenware squat jar-vase, H 15 cm, everted rim, shoulder with stepped throwing rings, rich green lead-type glaze running yellow-green, unglazed foot ring. Base glazed inside the foot with three kiln-stilt scars and an incised freehand script 'G R' monogram (flourished G and R) over '1944', the 1 written with a continental flag-stroke. Hand-signed, dated amateur or small studio work; maker not identified. Estimate A$60-80, current bid A$30.
